subject: science
concept: Observing and recording weather patterns over time to identify a trend
source_inspiration: adapted from NGSS Earth and Space Science Disciplinary Core Ideas — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student records simulated daily weather over a virtual week and reviews the data
exercise.pictorial: Student reads a simple weather-tracking chart and identifies the most common weather type
exercise.abstract: Student states a pattern noticed across a week of recorded weather data

misconception_flags: draws a conclusion from a single day's weather rather than the pattern across the whole data set

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
